target: Amenaza superior natural de los Pedrales de Korven; gran criatura excavadora.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: CREATURE / LARGE NATURAL FAUNA — CREATURE MUST BE THE PRIMARY FOCAL SUBJECT. Bestia excavadora grande y acorazada, adaptada a empujar bloques y desplazarse bajo piedra fracturada y tierra dura. Mostrar cuerpo completo, escala y anatomía de excavación. Debe ser organismo vivo, no golem ni roca animada.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: CREATURE / LARGE NATURAL FAUNA. The Quebrarrocas is the unmistakable primary focal subject and occupies roughly 50–65% of the frame. Show one complete adult in low three-quarter side view emerging onto the surface of the Pedrales de Korven. Massive low-slung torso; broad wedge-like head and neck integrated into extremely powerful shoulders; two enlarged digging forelimbs with broad organic claws for levering fractured ground; two shorter weight-bearing hind limbs; low center of gravity; thick organic abrasion-resistant dorsal and shoulder plates that overlap like tough hide rather than stone. Its head must have readable eyes and mouth so it remains clearly animal. Displaced slabs and a fresh shallow furrow demonstrate that it pushes through hard ground. Matte dusty gray-brown organic skin, restrained mineral camouflage. Korven is secondary: dry fractured plates, dust and wind.
negative_constraints: No golem, living rock, crystals, lava or magic
